Details
  • Paper: AnySplat: Feed-forward 3D Gaussian Splatting from Unconstrained Views, arXiv, 2025-05-29
  • Original code: https://github.com/InternRobotics/AnySplat at 5f5e208
  • Code licence: MIT AND LicenseRef-VGGT (permissive); files: LICENSE, LICENSE-VGGT
  • Weights licence: MIT
  • Licence evidence: https://github.com/InternRobotics/AnySplat/blob/5f5e208a7dd57d52e43ea0d553a95eab526e8775/LICENSE and https://huggingface.co/lhjiang/anysplat/blob/d2e8c343672646041ad4ea518184968f94362f01/README.md (license: mit)
  • Training data: Per the paper (arXiv 2505.23716) a mixture of public multi-view datasets; the repository ships CO3Dv2, DL3DV and ScanNet++ training configs. VGGT-1B initialisation.
  • Licence note: AnySplat's code and checkpoint are MIT; its VGGT copy (net/) is under the VGGT License (commercial use allowed). The checkpoint was fine-tuned from VGGT-1B, whose own weights are CC-BY-NC-4.0: the AnySplat authors release theirs as MIT.
  • Licence note: Upstream's Gaussian head file (vggt_dpt_gs_head.py) carries a stale Naver CC BY-NC-SA header from DUSt3R although the class used here is new code on the VGGT DPT head; this family reimplements that head (GSHead in model.py) and vendors none of the Naver-headed files.
  • Options: long_side = 448 (>= 14), voxel_size = 0.002 (>= 0.0)
  • Kernel libraries: fastbb, cudnn_hacc
  • Variants: anysplat
  • Outputs: depth, confidence, world_points, intrinsics, cam_to_world, gaussians; kind: scale_invariant
  • Input size: any H x W >= 1, resized or padded inside the model
  • Tested up to (portable, fp16, RTX 5060 Ti 16 GB): anysplat 3000x4000 (6.5 GiB peak allocated, 9.4 reserved)
  • anysplat 336x518, first call: portable + torch.compile 80 s (cold Inductor cache), TensorRT fp16 215 s (ONNX + engine).
  • anysplat original 336x518: the authors' mixed-precision option (bfloat16); InternRobotics/AnySplat@5f5e208a7dd5 EncoderAnySplat inference, long side 448, voxel_size 0.002
  • anysplat load / first call: original 8.32 s / 3.068 s (336x518), portable 2.46 s / 0.891 s (336x518), kernels 3.98 s / 0.73 s (336x518)
  • Protocol, first call, 3 warm-up, peak reset, median of 3 rounds x median of 5

Measured

640x512 crops, the 7 most co-visible views as sources; GT = depth rendered from the structured-light points. AbsRel / delta1 over GT pixels, after per-image median scaling unless the model takes the cameras (calibrated MVS: cameras, error in mm; PatchMatchNet also the depth range 425-935 mm, MVSAnywhere its own range from the camera baselines). Original = the original code named under Details, same checkpoint and protocol.
